reviewNotes: HOLD / canonical-backstage. The current provider page confirms SIM in Safe at 1 KZT/month and explicitly targets users leaving the country. Legacy IIN-only wording is stale: Beeline documents passport-based number/device registration for non-residents. 2026 community reports show app/USSD visibility/activation failures after technical changes, so treat remote enablement as currently unreliable rather than guaranteed.

events.outcome: Users reported SIM in Safe disappearing from the app and remote re-activation failing after technical changes; support reportedly confirmed the service could still be attached even when not visible. Treat remote enablement/status visibility as a live operational risk.

data.acquisitionSummary: Beeline Kazakhstan currently offers the dedicated SIM in Safe service for an existing Beeline number. Exact cheapest new-SIM acquisition price is not reconciled in this review.

keep.action: Enable SIM in Safe. Connection is free and the provider charges 1 KZT per month until disabled. If balance is below 1 KZT, the service is suspended until the balance is replenished.

data.chinaActivation: Do not assume a brand-new Kazakhstan line can be acquired/activated from China. For an existing line, the service is designed for long absence, but 2026 reports show remote service-enable/status friction.
data.kyc: Legacy IIN-only wording is incorrect. Beeline documents IIN for residents and foreign-passport details for non-residents when registering a number/device.
data.payment: Local balance/top-up rails; international payment acceptance is unresolved.
data.holdReason: Retention price is exceptionally strong, but new-line acquisition/payment are unresolved and fresh 2026 reports show remote SIM-in-Safe enablement/status friction.
data.tariffSummary: Dedicated number-retention service: 1 KZT/month, with current remote-management friction noted.
guideSteps: Acquire/register a Beeline Kazakhstan number under current rules.
Enable SIM in Safe while the service is reachable; keep at least enough balance for monthly 1 KZT deductions.
Because remote app/USSD state has shown 2026 failures, verify the service is actually active before relying on a long absence.
